title: ReasoningStrategySpec
description: Declarative source for a single reasoning-strategy agent under plugins/pmcro-omode/agents/. Declare once here; render_strategy.py generates the actual agents/<id>.md projection. Never hand-edit a generated .md directly once it has a spec.

id.description: Strategy id, kebab-case. Must match an existing or intended file name under agents/<id>.md.

family.description: One of the 7 families from CATALOG.md / selector.md. Must match exactly - the generator never invents a family name.

purpose.description: One-sentence statement of what this strategy forces or produces. Rendered under ## Purpose.

when_to_use.description: Bullet list rendered under ## When to Use.

when_not_to_use.description: Bullet list rendered under ## When Not to Use.

workflow.description: Ordered steps rendered as a numbered list under ## Workflow.

validation.description: Bullet list rendered under ## Validation - the checks a Checker would run against this strategy's actual use.

steps_description.description: Parenthetical describing what one ReasoningTraceFrame.steps entry represents for THIS strategy (e.g. 'one entry per step actually performed', 'each draft/critique/revision cycle'). Rendered under ## Output as '`steps` (<this>)'. Optional - omit entirely (not empty string) for the one confirmed real case (metacognitive-monitoring) where the real file has bare '`steps`,' with no parenthetical at all.

output_extra_fields.description: Optional extra fields appended after `result` in the Output line, e.g. ', `confidence`' or ', `confidence` (low/medium/high with reasons)'. Confirmed real and per-strategy: evidence-weighting and metacognitive-monitoring both have this, the other 32 do not. Empty string (default) for strategies without it.

trailing_note.description: Optional paragraph appended after the Output section, e.g. clarifying that a strategy's Action/tool-use language does not itself grant execute-provider-action. Confirmed real: react-loop and search-then-reason both have this, the other 32 do not. Empty string (default) for strategies without it.
